purpose: Teach: 真っ暗/滅多に/遥か/真夏/呆れ/入り込ん/通り過ぎ/つづき

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが部屋を真っ暗にして昔話をしてくださったぞ
lines.en: Gran — when I was young, Father would darken the room completely and tell us old stories.
lines.style: Distant, reaching back through time. Soft opening, like touching an old memory. Slow, measured cadence. Voice settles deeper as he speaks, grounded in the past tense.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃんは滅多に泣かないお方でしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, Grandpa was a man who hardly ever cried, wasn't he, dear?
lines.style: Warm, affirming tone. Gentle rise on the question. Not seeking answer but offering shared recognition. Soft, intimate — speaking as though he's right there with them.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お祖父ちゃんと遥か遠くの山に登ったぞ
lines.en: Gran — when I was young, I climbed a far distant mountain with Grandfather.
lines.style: Voice rises slightly with the effort of the climb. Measured breath. The memory is vivid, physical. Slight pause before 'far distant' — the distance echoes in the delivery.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、真夏でも畑仕事を続けられたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandfather kept working in the fields even in the height of summer, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Soft praise beneath the surface. Question-lilt gentle, not probing. Voice carries quiet respect for his endurance. Slight fade at the end — letting the listener sit with it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、息子の失敗に呆れたお祖父ちゃんを覚えてるぞ
lines.en: Gran — when I was young, I remember Grandfather's disappointment when my brother failed.
lines.style: Quieter now. The admission carries a slight weight. Careful pacing — he's choosing each word. The memory is both clear and painful, held at arm's length.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、よそ者がお家に入り込んだ時、追い返されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: When an outsider tried to enter the house, Grandfather turned them away, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Calm, factual statement wrapped in affection. No judgment in the tone — just stating what was. The question mark is gentle, almost rhetorical. Voice steady, assured.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが家の前を通り過ぎる人に挨拶をされたぞ
lines.en: Gran — when I was young, Father would greet the people who passed by our house.
lines.style: Slight warmth enters now. The pace lifts marginally, less weighed. An image of kindness — simple, observed. Voice settles into quieter approval.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お話のつづきを聞かせてくださったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandfather would continue the story for us, wouldn't he, dear?
lines.style: Voice softens with closure. Intimate, almost conspiratorial — she's inviting him into the circle of the memory one last time. Trailing off gently, like a story finding its natural end.
